controls.title: ICT third-party risk strategy
controls.description: A strategy on ICT third-party risk, incl. a policy on the use of ICT services supporting critical or important functions, adopted and reviewed by the management body.
clauseMatchPatterns: policy on the use of ICT services

controls.title: Register of Information
controls.description: Maintain and update a register of information on all contractual arrangements for the use of ICT services provided by ICT third-party providers, distinguishing those supporting critical or important functions.

controls.title: Pre-contract due diligence
controls.description: Before entering into a contractual arrangement, assess whether the provider is appropriate, undertake due diligence, and identify/assess conflicts of interest and subcontracting risk.

controls.title: Ongoing monitoring of provider performance
controls.description: Monitor, on an ongoing basis, the performance of the ICT third-party provider against the contractual arrangement and its ICT risk.

controls.title: Exit strategy for critical or important functions
controls.description: Maintain exit strategies for ICT services supporting critical or important functions, ensuring exit without disruption, in breach of requirements, or degradation of service.

controls.title: Clear and complete description of services
controls.description: A clear and complete description of all functions and ICT services to be provided, indicating whether subcontracting of a critical or important function (or material part) is permitted.

controls.title: Locations of data processing and storage
controls.description: The locations (regions or countries) where the contracted or subcontracted functions and ICT services are to be provided and where data is to be processed, including the storage location, and a requirement to notify in advance of changes.
clauseMatchPatterns: where data is to be processed

controls.title: Availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of data
controls.description: Provisions on availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality in relation to the protection of data, including personal data.

controls.title: Service level descriptions
controls.description: Service level descriptions, including updates and revisions, with precise quantitative and qualitative performance targets to allow effective monitoring and timely corrective action.

controls.title: Assistance on ICT incidents
controls.description: The obligation of the provider to provide assistance in the case of an ICT incident related to the service, at no additional cost or at a cost determined ex-ante.
clauseMatchPatterns: assistance in the case of an ICT incident

controls.title: Cooperation with competent authorities
controls.description: The obligation of the provider to fully cooperate with the competent authorities and resolution authorities of the financial entity.

controls.title: Termination rights
controls.description: Termination rights and related minimum notice periods, in accordance with the expectations of competent and resolution authorities (breach, impediments to supervision, weaknesses in ICT risk management).

controls.title: Exit and transition assistance
controls.description: Exit strategies, notably a mandatory adequate transition period during which the provider continues services, and provisions for the return and deletion of data.

controls.title: Full service levels for critical or important functions
controls.description: Full service level descriptions, including updates and revisions, with precise quantitative and qualitative performance targets, for ICT services supporting critical or important functions.

controls.title: Business contingency plans and resilience testing
controls.description: The requirement for the provider to implement and test business contingency plans and to have ICT security measures, tools and policies providing an appropriate level of security, for CIF-supporting services.

controls.title: ICT security measures for critical or important functions
controls.description: The requirement to implement and test ICT security measures, tools and policies providing an appropriate level of security for the provision of services supporting critical or important functions.

controls.title: Access, inspection and audit rights
controls.description: The rights of the financial entity to monitor performance on an ongoing basis, including unrestricted rights of access, inspection and audit, and the ability to participate in pooled or third-party audits, for CIF-supporting services.

controls.title: Subcontracting conditions and right to object
controls.description: Conditions under which subcontracting of ICT services supporting critical or important functions is permitted, including the requirement to notify material changes and the financial entity's right to object or terminate.
